「慎二」
ベッドには慎二の亡骸がある。
それ以外には何もない。
ここで何があったのか。
そんな事、読み取れる筈もないのに、
「
桜」
慎二を手にかけたのが、彼女だと判ってしまった。

pages.en:
“Shinji.”

His body lies on the bed.

There is nothing else.

I could not possibly read what happened here from the room, and yet—

“—Sakura.”

I know she is the one who killed him.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Shinji.”
Shinji’s corpse is on the bed.
There’s nothing else.
What happened here?
There’s no way I would know, but…
“
Sakura.”
…Somehow, I can tell that Sakura killed him.

pages.ja:
「……………………」
考えがまとまらない。
慎二の遺体。
桜の行方。
昨日の夜から。桜を抱きしめた夜から半日も経っていないというのに、どうして、こんな、事に。

昨日の夜から。桜を抱きしめた夜から半日も経っていないというのに、どうして、こんな、事に。
pages.en:
“……………………”

My thoughts will not come together.

Shinji's body.

Sakura's disappearance.

It has not even been half a day since last night—since the night I held Sakura in my arms. How could this have happened…?
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…………”
I can’t think.
Shinji’s corpse.
Sakura’s whereabouts.
It’s only been half a day since I embraced Sakura, so how did it end up like this?

背後には誰もいない。
この屋敷に人がいない事は判っている。
いま響いたものは、ここではない何処かにいる臓硯の声にすぎない。

“…!”

There is no one behind me.

I know this mansion is empty.

What I heard was merely Zouken's voice, carried here from somewhere else.

pages.mirrorMoon: “Zouken…! What did you do to Sakura…!?”

うむ、不肖の孫と呼ぶのもこれ限りじゃな。

“Nothing. As you can see, my worthless grandson simply met his end when his younger sister turned the tables on him. Hardly a matter worth such commotion.

“But—hmm. I suppose that is the last time I shall call him worthless.

“Useless though the boy was, he fulfilled his role admirably in the end.”

this will be the last time I call him an unworthy grandson.

呵々と笑う。

pages.en:
He laughs with delight.

I cannot see the old mage, but I know his face is twisting into something hideous.
pages.mirrorMoon:
He laughs.
I can’t see the old magus, but I’m sure he’s laughing with a hideous face.

桜が自らの影を受け入れるには、この世に絶望して貰わねばならなかったからのう』

pages.en:
“Shinji's role…?”

“Indeed. I could not induce Sakura to take the necessary step myself. She has grown a touch too fond of hating me. Either you or Shinji had to break the dam holding her back.

“For Sakura to accept her own shadow, she first had to despair of this world.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Shinji’s role…?”
“Yes. I cannot make her put her mind to it. She hates me too much. So I had to have you or Shinji break her down.
I needed Sakura to feel despair in this world to have her accept her own shadow.”

“I never imagined she would grow to possess such endurance.”

“Ideally, I wanted you to betray Sakura yourself. Then she would not have stopped at this incomplete awakening. Body and soul, she would have become the shadow itself!

“But that is only a matter of time.

“With Shinji's death, she has finally accepted her position. We need only watch. She will attack humanity as instinct dictates and destroy herself through her own gluttony.

“My work begins once that is—”

pages.en:
I strike.

With all my strength, I drive my fist into the darkness from which his voice speaks—into what is, in truth, only a wall.

Though I act without conscious thought, the blow carries every trace of magical energy I possess through the wall and purges the darkness embedded in the room.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I punch the wall.
With all my might, I lash out at the darkness where the voice is coming from.
I unconsciously fill my hand with magical energy, which is transmitted into the wall and sweeps the darkness from the room.

“—Shut up! Show yourself, Zouken…! I'll tear you limb from limb right here…!”

『いやいや、残念だがそういう訳にもいかぬ。マキリ五百年の宿願に、ようやく手が届いたのだ。
ここでおぬしに殺される訳にもいかぬし、おぬしを仕留めるほど恩知らずでもないのでな』
pages.jaRuby:
『いやいや、残念だがそういう訳にもいかぬ。マキリ五百年の宿願に、ようやく手が届いたのだ。
ここでおぬしに殺される訳にもいかぬし、おぬしを仕留めるほど恩知らずでもないのでな』
pages.en:
“No, no. Regrettably, I cannot oblige you. The five-hundred-year aspiration of the Makiri is at last within my grasp.

“I cannot allow you to kill me now. Nor am I so ungrateful that I would strike you down.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Well, I am afraid I cannot do that. The goal the Makiri have sought for five hundred years is within my grasp.
I cannot be killed now, yet I’m not so ungrateful as to kill you.”

pages.ja: 「恩知らずだと……？ ふざけるな、誰がおまえに尻尾を振った……！」
pages.jaRuby: 「恩知らずだと……？ ふざけるな、誰がおまえに尻尾を振った……！」
pages.en: “Ungrateful…? Don't make me laugh. When the hell did I ever wag my tail for you…!?”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Ungrateful…? Shut up! When did I do anything for you…!?”

pages.ja:
『振ったとも。おぬしはあそこまで桜を育ててくれたではないか。あの娘に、他者を欲するという感情を教え込んだのは他ならぬおぬしよ。
そう、ワシは感謝しておるよ衛宮士郎。此度の儀はおぬしがいてこその成功だった。
故に殺しはせん。おぬしには、見事成長したアレの姿を見てもらわねばならぬからのぅ……！』

pages.en:
“You did indeed. Did you not nurture Sakura to such splendid maturity? None other than you taught that girl the desire for another human being.

“Yes, I am grateful to you, Shirou Emiya. This ritual could never have succeeded without you.

“Therefore I shall not kill you. You must be allowed to witness what she has so magnificently become…!”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“You did. You raised Sakura.
Before, she merely endured, but you taught her how
You were the one who taught her how it felt
to desire others.
Yes, I appreciate what you did, Emiya Shirou. This ritual was a success because of you.
That is why I will not kill you. I need you to see her after she matures…!”

“Z-Zouken—”

“Heh heh heh! No one can stop her now. Having murdered her brother, she can no longer turn back.

“The Einzbern Holy Grail. She will absorb Archer's soul from that little girl and seize the key that leads to the gate.

“Then it will be checkmate. The dearest wish of the Makiri—the re-creation of the Third Magic—will at last be fulfilled…!”
